question: When a hosted record exists for the Octoparse MCP template lane, should crawler-scraper/octoparse return to self_hosted true?
why: crawler-scraper/octoparse offers a hosted lane that Octoparse runs (preset templates as cloud tasks through the MCP server, free for Free and Basic accounts, and paid Cloud Extraction) beside the desktop application and the CLI that the user installs and runs, so it carries self_hosted false while one record holds both. Another open question proposes a hosted record crawler-scraper/octoparse-mcp from a discover unit. After that record exists and the hosted lane text leaves crawler-scraper/octoparse, the remaining offer is software that the user installs and runs, and a unit sets self_hosted true with the local extraction page as evidence (the user's own computer supplies the processing, memory, storage, power and network).
